title: Android app type is ok but the Korean keyboard turns input into jamo
symptom: You typed an English ID with app type, but the field contains Korean jamo
cause: adb input text sends key events, so the Gboard Korean layout composes them. The result differs even for ASCII values
fix: launch_cli.py app type --ime ascii --text <value> (switches to the Maestro IME while typing, then restores)
Manual: adb shell ime set dev.mobile.maestro/.input.MaestroInputMethodService, type, then restore the original IME
The IME is a device-wide setting. If another session uses the device, ask first
